cosmology: flat ΛCDM, H0 67.66, Ωm 0.3111, Ωr 9.1e-5 (Planck 2018); comoving distances of heliocentric redshifts

local.format: Float32LE x, y, z (Mly, J2000 equatorial), absolute Ks mag
local.source: 2MASS Redshift Survey (Huchra et al. 2012, ApJS 199, 26; CDS J/ApJS/199/26): every galaxy with Ks ≤ 11.75 and heliocentric cz ≥ 300 km/s; absolute magnitude from the total Ks (Ktmag)
local.credit: 2MASS Redshift Survey, Huchra et al. 2012, ApJS 199, 26. 2MASS is a joint project of the University of Massachusetts and IPAC/Caltech, funded by NASA and the NSF.

deep.format: Float32LE x, y, z (Mly, J2000 equatorial), redshift (negative for quasars); galaxies first, then quasars
deep.source: SDSS DR17 SpecObj via SkyServer SQL search: galaxies with zWarning = 0 and 0.01 < z < 0.7 (1 in 13 by specObjID), quasars with zWarning = 0 and z < 6 (4 in 25 by specObjID)
deep.credit: Sloan Digital Sky Survey DR17 (Abdurro'uf et al. 2022, ApJS 259, 35). Funding for the SDSS has been provided by the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, the U.S. Department of Energy Office of Science, the National Science Foundation, and the Participating Institutions. www.sdss.org
